segments.thag6.12:3.1: [saṃ. ni.1.188,250]“Ubhinnamatthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca;
segments.thag6.12:3.3: Paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
segments.thag6.12:4.1: [saṃ. ni.1.188,250]“Ubhinnaṃ tikicchantaṃ taṃ, attano ca parassa ca;
segments.thag6.12:4.3: Janā maññanti bāloti, ye dhammassa akovidā.
segments.thag6.12:5.3: Uppajje ce rase taṇhā, puttamaṃsūpamaṃ sara.
segments.thag6.12:6.1: “Sace dhāvati cittaṃ te, kāmesu ca bhavesu ca;
segments.thag6.12:6.3: Khippaṃ niggaṇha satiyā, kiṭṭhādaṃ viya duppasun”ti;
